> [!info] Local Roblox Creator Docs mirror
> Mirrored from [luau/booleans.md](https://github.com/Roblox/creator-docs/blob/main/content/en-us/luau/booleans.md). Published page: [https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/booleans](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/booleans).

The **boolean** data type, or `bool`, has a value of either `true` or `false`.

## Conditionals

If a value isn't `false` or `nil`, Luau evaluates it as `true` in [[external/roblox-creator-docs/luau/control-structures#if-statements|conditional statements]]. Unlike many other languages, Luau considers both zero and the empty string as `true`.

## Operators

You can formulate complex conditions with [[external/roblox-creator-docs/luau/operators#relational|relational]] and [[external/roblox-creator-docs/luau/operators#logical|logical]] operators.
